Senior Backend Engineer - Core Infrastructure
Stripe is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to scale financial transaction systems.

Responsibilities:
• Architect resilient distributed transaction engines.
• Scale PostgreSQL databases and Kafka event pipelines.
• Mentor junior engineers and run architectural post-mortems.

Requirements:
• 5+ years with Go, Java, or Rust in high-throughput systems (Must have).
• Deep knowledge of distributed consensus, ACID transactions, and partitioning (Required).
• Experience with PostgreSQL database indexing and query tuning (Must have).
• Mentoring junior engineers and cross-functional leadership (Bonus point).

Build UI components with React.
